weapons.name: Snowball Launcher
weapons.desc: Fires balls of frozen coolant. Locks systems up, hurts nobody's feelings.

weapons.name: Icicle Lance
weapons.desc: A spike of ice fired fast enough to punch through one shield layer.

augments.name: Lucky Stocking
augments.desc: Something nice turns up in every wreck: 10% more scrap.

augments.name: Cocoa Dispenser
augments.desc: Warm drinks for everyone: your crew slowly heal anywhere and move 5% faster.

sectors.name: The Frostlight Drift
sectors.blurb: Ice comets, frozen moons and a festival season that even the pyrates respect. Mostly.
intro: Snowflakes the size of shuttles drift past the canopy.
The Frostlight Drift. Somebody has strung lights between the beacons.

events.text: Someone has built a snowman out of three ice asteroids. It is a hundred metres tall and wearing a cargo container as a hat.

effect.text: Your crew fire a long orange fuel tank into its face. It looks wonderful. Morale is sky high.
The cargo container is full of festive salvage.

success.text: Snow everywhere. Inside the snow, a frozen supply pod.

fail.text: A block of ice the size of a building drifts into your hull.

events.text: A cheerful freighter hung with lights pulls alongside. "Happy Winterfest! We're giving gifts to every ship we meet. Or you can give one, if you like."

success.text: A beautifully wrapped weapon. Their gift wrapping is better than their targeting software.

fail.text: Socks. Very warm socks, and a bag of scrap tucked inside.

effect.text: They are moved to tears and give you a stocking for luck.
They wave back with every light on the ship.

events.text: A Sloog choir is singing to passing ships from a frozen moon. The harmonies make your hull hum.

effect.text: {who} hits the high note. The choir is so impressed they give you their cocoa machine.
They sing your ship's name into a song. Your pilot won't stop smiling.

events.text: Your sensors find an asteroid with a strange density reading. Your science officer says it is, unmistakably, a fruitcake.

success.text: It is mostly candied minerals. Valuable ones.

fail.text: It is denser than it looks. A drill breaks.

events.text: A winter market fills a ring station: stalls of hot food, warm coats and, in the back, ship parts at festival prices.

choices.text: Grab hot food for the crew (10 scrap).

effect.text: Everyone is full, warm and happy.

events.text: A pyrate ship hails you. "Truce for the festival? Snowball fight instead. Winner gets the loser's snowball launcher."

success.text: You win, fair and square. They hand over the launcher.

fail.text: You lose, and they keep their launcher, but they share their cocoa.

effect.text: They are not happy about that.
